channel.title: Mr. X — Daily X Briefing
channel.description: A private daily audio briefing on what a handful of influential X accounts are saying: themes, engagement, analysis and business angles. By Mr. X.
channel.itunes:author: Mr. X

item.title: X Briefing — Oct 29, 2026
item.description: A viral clip of a struggling worker becomes a flashpoint for working-class money stress, alongside a white-collar story about laid-off high earners in their 40s. Also: felony charges over hidden-camera election videos and the midterm turnout debate, a fact check on a federal judge's misconduct case, AI eating back-office jobs, and the buy-borrow-die wealth strategy. Ends with labeled analysis, two new forecasts, and speculative business angles.

item.description: The day AI came for the office job, at least on paper: Anthropic's IPO filing and Microsoft's voluntary buyout offer, with the facts behind both. item.title: X Briefing — Oct 25, 2026 (first edition)
item.description: The first edition of the daily X briefing. Today: a viral backlash against Airbnb after its new host checkout rules, and the fight over a second candidate with the same name on Alaska's Senate ballot, plus the Justice Department lawsuit behind it. Also: why a Tom Cruise film flopped at the box office, an energy-based currency idea, and the case for just trying things in business. Ends with labeled analysis on which posts drew real agreement and which only drew reach.
